official_latest_comparison.comparison_policy: Compare API index values rounded to one decimal against official PIB values published to one decimal. Do not recompute published growth rates.

ppi_series_identity.evidence: MoSPI states the entire 2022-23 IIP series was revised with Output PPI, superseding the 2022-23 WPI-based series, with updated source-agency data incorporated since April 2022.
ppi_series_identity.cross_validation: The same official 2022-23 IIP API returned 43/43 May-2026 values matching the latest 2026-10-28 PIB release after revisions; April-2026 API values also match 43/43 against that release.
ppi_series_identity.caveat: The API row schema does not contain an explicit deflator field. PPI series identity is established by the official series-level supersession notice and direct row-level match to the latest official IIP release, not by a per-row deflator field.

original_june_1_pib_crosswalk: Retained as separate supplemental evidence for the superseded WPI-based initial release; not overwritten or relabelled.
production_impact: No production selector, RANKING_SCORE, +1 PRESSURE_FADE, CORE-672, or hard-gate logic was changed. This is source evidence only.
